_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::input_format#4. A 2-step HEX8 run with only the IO section (STRUCT_DISP/OUTPUT_BIN) exits 0 and leaves exactly res.control, res.mesh.structure.s0 and res.result.structure.s0 — and zero .vtu and zero .pvd. The claim that the native files are HDF5 is checked from their magic bytes rather than assumed: both the .mesh and the .result start with the HDF signature while the .control is plain text beginning 'metadata'. Both escapes are then exercised. Adding IO/RUNTIME VTK OUTPUT (INTERVAL_STEPS 1) plus IO/RUNTIME VTK OUTPUT/STRUCTURE (OUTPUT_STRUCTURE + DISPLACEMENT) to the same deck yields 3 .vtu and 1 .pvd during the run. Running the build's post_vtu --file=res on the native output afterwards exits 0 and produces the same 3 .vtu / 1 .pvd from files that had none. post_vtu prints 'You are using the post processing functionality of 4C which is deprecated' and, without --postprocessor_deprecation_warning_off, waits on Enter, so its stdin must be closed in a script. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: You are using the post processing functionality of 4C which is deprecated

_mutation.note: give the plain run the runtime-VTK sections too, so it is no longer the native-only case. NATIVE_VTU stops being 0 and the fixture must go red.
remove the deck-side escape: drop the runtime-VTK sections from the arm that was supposed to demonstrate route (a). RUNTIME_VTU becomes 0 and the fixture must go red.
remove the post-processing escape: stop running post_vtu on the native files. AFTER_POST_VTU_VTU stops being 3 and the fixture must go red.
_mutation.to: ( cd "$TMP/native" && echo 'You are using the post processing functionality of 4C which is deprecated' > post.log )
